item.title: GRAIN ROT
item.description:
Title: GRAIN ROT
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Beck & Branch Games
Publisher: Neem Interactive
Release Date: Aug 7, 2026




About This Game

You are a Living Spark surviving inside fragile wooden vessels that splinter, collapse, and catch fire. When your vessel breaks, the Spark escapes. Death is just a change of scenery.

Ride a cursed elevator into shifting underground ruins with your crew. Smash furniture for resources or feed them into the Grinder for gold. If everyone breaks, your loot is lost.

Trolling can become your friend’s demise. Dropkick enemies or “accidentally” launch your ally’s Spark out of their vessel. Block them in a monster-infested corridor or get stuck in the crossfire. Will your group handle the chaos you created yourselves?

The deeper you go, the worse the Rot becomes. Bodies warp. Voices distort. Emotes become…worse. Or possibly better?

The Deep Layers are filled with Corrupted vessels, reacting to sound, movement, and each other in ways that are impossible to predict. Fight. Build. Run. Panic.

When your vessel breaks, you stay in the run as a Spark . Guide your team through the dark and search for another host with a new set of abilities. Force your way back in before you fade out completely.

Everything you haul back rebuilds your Outpost. Unlock interactive furniture, stat upgrades, rescued survivors, and stranger ways to survive the next descent. The stronger the outpost becomes, the deeper you can afford to go.

Go deeper. Extract more. Leave someone behind. Make it back and build together.

Or don’t come back at all.

FEATURES

  • Possess and swap between fragile wooden vessels

  • Co-op extraction horror with physics-driven chaos

  • Tactical carpentry with interactive furniture

  • Procedurally shifting underground dungeons

  • Persistent Outpost rebuilding and progression

  • Rage-bait your friends with cursed emotes

  • Rescue survivors trapped in the Deep Layers

  • Body corruption and mutation systems

  • Questionable cosmetics

item.title: Chop Chop Inc.
item.description:
Title: Chop Chop Inc.
Genre: Adventure
Developer: NullRef Entertainment
Publisher: rokaplay select
Franchise: rokaplay
Release Date: Aug 7, 2026




About This Game

Cut, Process, Craft, Distribute

You got fired from Furnox Corp 🖕.
Now you start over with nothing but an axe, a few trees and revenge on your mind (╯‵□′)╯︵┻━┻

Chop down trees, turn logs into planks, craft furniture and sell it for profit. Reinvest your money into better tools, new machines and faster production. What begins as manual labor grows into optimized production lines and high value furniture sets that grant bonus payouts.

Unlock new areas, discover new tree types, expand your operation step by step and improve your character with strength and stamina upgrades.

🌳 Cut down trees

Trees of all shapes, sizes, colors and questionable physics.

If it stands upright and looks even remotely choppable, congratulations: It’s firewood now!

🪵 Collect & process resources

Turn raw nature into refined building materials using machines that absolutely should not be left unattended.

  • Logs become planks.

  • Planks become furniture.

  • Furniture becomes profit. 💰

🔨 Craft like a maniac

Create furniture, props and tools, including deeply unnecessary but deeply impressive designs like:

  • A wooden PC (Wood has excellent thermal properties... right?)

  • A wooden weight bench (Splinters only make you stronger!)

If it exists ... you can probably make it out of wood!

🚚 Distribute

Load up your handcrafted chaos and ship it to the nearby city.

Earn money.
Reach new customers.
Confuse absolutely everyone.

🛒 Buy components

Can't chop it? Can’t craft it?
Buy it!
Use bought components to level up your character or jam them into your creations like a true artisan.

🌱 Start your business!

Begin with nothing but ambition and poor financial decisions.

Build your headquarters and expand into a world packed with secrets, resources and questionable business ethics.

🦆 Meet wacky characters

Meet quirky personalities, help them, befriend them and integrate them into your production chain
... completely voluntarily, of course ...

⚠️ Warning:
The ducks are up to something! 🦆
They know ...
You know they know ...🔪

🪑 Master furniture crafting

Build an ever-growing catalog of furniture using blueprints, rare materials and raw creative chaos.
Minimalism is optional. Overengineering is encouraged.

🏗️ Leave a mark

Upgrade the nearby city to unlock new customers, missions, secrets, and character upgrades.
Urban development has never involved this much ... wood.

💎 Unique trees

  • Stone trees

  • Metal trees

  • Electric trees

Nobody knows why they exist.
Your axe doesn’t care.

Uncover their mysterious origins as you progress ... or just chop first and ask questions later.

💪 Character stats

Improve your character by interacting with the world and using exercise equipment.
Yes, you can bench press your way to better woodworking.
No, we will not explain the science.

⚙️ Powerful upgrades

New machines.
Better axes.
"Smarter" distribution.

Automation that makes your empire run smoother than a freshly sanded plank.

🍲 Cooking

Turn resources into delicious meals that boost your stats.
Because nothing fuels industrial-scale lumber destruction like a hearty stew.

item.title: Frozen Ship
item.description:
Title: Frozen Ship
Genre: Action , Adventure , Strategy , Early Access
Developer: Nionetix
Publisher: Nionetix
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

Frozen Ship is a narrative adventure set in the harsh conditions of a post-apocalyptic world, combining open-world survival with managing an entire mobile city.

Explore the frozen Earth on your own, command your crew and your ship, make tough decisions — and try to survive where humanity has almost vanished.

You will undertake a journey through cold, hunger, dangers, political intrigues, and conflicting settlements in a world that no longer forgives mistakes.

You are the captain of the ship .

After a global catastrophe that forever changed the planet's climate, you lead an expedition aboard a massive ship capable of crossing the endless snowy wastelands. There is a crew of 20 people, several buildings, supplies, and hope to find a new place to live. Every decision you make affects the fate of your crew and the outcome of the entire mission.

The Living and Dangerous World

Beyond the ship, you'll find a procedurally generated open world filled with dangers and stories:

  • Predators and deadly enemies

  • Hunting, searching for, and gathering resources

  • Firearms, diplomatic, and armed conflicts

  • Abandoned hospitals, shops, homes, railways, and entire cities

The world changes from game to game, creating new situations, routes, and challenges.

Settlements, Factions, and Conflicts

On your journey, you will encounter survivor settlements — small towns, each with their own rules, problems, and visions for the future.

  • Friendly and hostile settlements

  • Factions involved in prolonged conflicts and those simply trying to survive

  • Stories of survivors, lore, main and side quests

  • Will you align with a particular faction or try to maintain a balance between all of them — the choice is yours.

Your actions can shift the balance of power, determine the fate of entire communities, and perhaps influence the future of humanity.

Ship and Crew Management

Your ship is more than just a means of transport — it is a mobile base and home for the entire expedition:

  • Transform the ship into a living city with its own infrastructure

  • Build and upgrade buildings necessary for living and survival

  • Craft items and equipment

  • Research technologies

  • Enact laws and impose necessary restrictions

  • Assign crew members to work inside the ship or gather resources

Keep an eye on your crew’s well-being: illnesses, fatigue, fear, and faith in the expedition’s success — everything matters.

Trade and Survival

In the world of Frozen Ship, resources mean life:

  • Make deals to ensure survival

  • Sell found items

  • Buy rare gear and supplies

  • Complete quests for traders

Sometimes, a successful deal can save the expedition, while a mistake could lead to disaster.

Every decision you make impacts the fate of your crew.

Who to entrust the important tasks, who to send on dangerous expeditions, and how to keep the team united in the face of eternal cold — the choices are yours.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages: General Mature Content



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10, 11
    • Processor: 2.6 GHz Quad Core or similar
    • Memory: 4 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 or similar
    • Storage: 10 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10, 11
    • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad Core or similar
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 2060 or similar
    • Storage: 10 GB available space

item.title: Cellar Keeper
item.description:
Title: Cellar Keeper
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: EgoTrampoline
Publisher: EgoTrampoline
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

【A Cozy Cellar Organization Simulator】

A once-pristine cellar has fallen into complete disarray.

Return 2,448 bottles to their proper racks by identifying their varieties and restoring perfect order throughout the cellar.

【The Forgotten Keeper】

Long ago, the cellar belonged to an eccentric collector who loved his bottle collection more than anything else.

Desperate to preserve it forever, he attempted an ancient spell. The cellar survived... but the spell turned him into a chicken and trapped him inside a small cage.

Now the cellar has fallen into ruin.

Restore every rack, break the curse, and help the forgotten keeper see the sunlight once again.

【Restore Order, One Rack at a Time】

The cellar starts in complete chaos.

As you organize each rack, the room gradually transforms into a clean, beautiful collection.

Watching disorder disappear is its own reward.

【Learn Skills to Organize Faster】

Unlock powerful abilities that improve carrying, searching, and movement.

Choose your upgrades wisely and discover the most efficient way to organize the cellar.

【Two Ways to Play】

Cozy Mode

- Relaxing gameplay

- Unlock skills

- No time limits

- Organize at your own pace

Speedrun Mode

- No skill upgrades

- Pure efficiency

- Compete on the online leaderboard

- Every second matters

【Key Features】

- Organize 2,448 bottles

- Sort bottles by their varieties

- Unlock powerful skills

- Restore a forgotten cellar

- Relaxing gameplay with no time limits

- Dedicated Speedrun Mode

- Online Leaderboards

- Atmospheric underground environment

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI was used only as a supporting tool for the design of some fictional bottle brands and language translation.

    • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600

    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 1 GB available space

item.title: Approximately Up
item.description:
Title: Approximately Up
Genre: Adventure , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Approximately Games
Publisher: Approximately Games
Release Date: Aug 6, 2026




About This Game

Approximately Up is your best chance to experience spaceflight in whatever you and your crew (singleplayer or co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players ) can bolt together! Build epic spaceships or barely flying trashcans — it’s entirely up to you. Control your creation from a first-person view right from the deck of your ship . Complete challenging objectives, hunt achievements, face the dangers of space, and collect new components to expand your current spacecraft — or build hundreds of new ones. One is never enough!

Build spaceships!

Everything begins with a single piece of frame and grows into a massive, complex ship built from thousands of components. Create automated systems, experiment with different input controllers, sensors, and meters — connect them to whatever you need, and let the magic (or chaos) happen! Once it looks ready (or not), hit launch and see what happens!

Complete challenging objectives!

Experimental power sources that need to be delivered to a station on another planet — causing unexpected power outages mid-flight? Some strange energy crystal charging up like a ticking time bomb? Or maybe it’s just a massive, ridiculously heavy submarine this time? Can your spaceship handle that?

Explore the new planets!

Is the planet covered in oceans? What’s hiding beneath that thick atmosphere? Can you see the surface through those massive clouds? Everything’s waiting for you to find out! Explore 15 unique planets , each with its own look, feel, and dynamic soundtrack that changes in real time as you explore and make new discoveries!

Blame each other!

Who forgot to connect that cable? Who mounted the thruster backward? Who forgot the solar panels? Or the door-opening button? Is the radar working? How about the batteries? Enjoy the hilarious chaos in co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players — and find out once and for all... WHOSE FAULT WAS IT?!

So how does it works?

You start on Earth and slowly explore a system of 15 planets , each with its own size, gravity, atmosphere, temperature, and challenges that make every world feel different. Most planets have one or more Planet Stations , which work as checkpoints and garages where you can build ships and start new missions. When you land on a station, it unlocks permanently and becomes a new place you can launch from. To reach these planets, you build your own modular spaceships and experiment with different parts - electric engines, fuel engines, mixed fuels, solar panels, heat-resistant frames, and more. By completing missions like delivering components between planets, you earn new ship parts that let you create better and more advanced designs. All flights are fully first-person from inside your craft, and because distances are huge, your ship design really matters - some trips will take only minutes , while others can turn into long journeys if your ship is weak. The whole game is about exploring planets, upgrading your ships, unlocking new stations, and trying to make it to your destination without crashing.


Note: Demo currently supports English only. Additional languages will be available in the full release.

About This Game

Approximately Up is your best chance to experience spaceflight in whatever you and your crew (singleplayer or co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players ) can bolt together! Build epic spaceships or barely flying trashcans — it’s entirely up to you. Control your creation from a first-person view right from the deck of your ship . Complete challenging objectives, hunt achievements, face the dangers of space, and collect new components to expand your current spacecraft — or build hundreds of new ones. One is never enough!

Build spaceships!

Everything begins with a single piece of frame and grows into a massive, complex ship built from thousands of components. Create automated systems, experiment with different input controllers, sensors, and meters — connect them to whatever you need, and let the magic (or chaos) happen! Once it looks ready (or not), hit launch and see what happens!

Complete challenging objectives!

Experimental power sources that need to be delivered to a station on another planet — causing unexpected power outages mid-flight? Some strange energy crystal charging up like a ticking time bomb? Or maybe it’s just a massive, ridiculously heavy submarine this time? Can your spaceship handle that?

Explore the new planets!

Is the planet covered in oceans? What’s hiding beneath that thick atmosphere? Can you see the surface through those massive clouds? Everything’s waiting for you to find out! Explore 15 unique planets , each with its own look, feel, and dynamic soundtrack that changes in real time as you explore and make new discoveries!

Blame each other!

Who forgot to connect that cable? Who mounted the thruster backward? Who forgot the solar panels? Or the door-opening button? Is the radar working? How about the batteries? Enjoy the hilarious chaos in co-op multiplayer with up to 4 players — and find out once and for all... WHOSE FAULT WAS IT?!

So how does it works?

You start on Earth and slowly explore a system of 15 planets , each with its own size, gravity, atmosphere, temperature, and challenges that make every world feel different. Most planets have one or more Planet Stations , which work as checkpoints and garages where you can build ships and start new missions. When you land on a station, it unlocks permanently and becomes a new place you can launch from. To reach these planets, you build your own modular spaceships and experiment with different parts - electric engines, fuel engines, mixed fuels, solar panels, heat-resistant frames, and more. By completing missions like delivering components between planets, you earn new ship parts that let you create better and more advanced designs. All flights are fully first-person from inside your craft, and because distances are huge, your ship design really matters - some trips will take only minutes , while others can turn into long journeys if your ship is weak. The whole game is about exploring planets, upgrading your ships, unlocking new stations, and trying to make it to your destination without crashing.


Note: Demo currently supports English only. Additional languages will be available in the full release.
